topic: Do We Only Use 10% of Our Brain?
research_summary: Channel check: 27 Nov 2026 (channel_trends, YouTube Analytics 28 d): 48 subscribers (952 to 1,000), Shorts 1,822 views / 40.5 % viewed, long-form 76 views / 15.9 % viewed, 1.08 subscribers per 1,000 views; top: Hindi GPS video 840 views, flute cover 687, Haunted Hotel 505; Partner Program eligibility: fan-funding tier 0.1 %, ads tier 0.0 % (slowest: subscribers and long-form hours, 1.8 h). Patterns brief 27 Nov: slots 1) space+nature (1.21x, n=14), 2) tech (0.95x, n=6), 3) myth (explore slot, n=0). Learning applied: rules 1 (payoff before 22 s), 2 (the viewer's own head), 5 (series promise: 'Which myth next?' and the Myth Busters series name), 7 (Myth explore slot). First Myth Busters video: its own data point (n=0). Candidates (/40): (1) Do we only use 10% of our brain 33 (a belief 65 % of people agree with, a clean test, safe science), (2) Can you see the Great Wall from space 31 (space overlap with slot 1), (3) Does lightning never strike twice 30. Winner (1). Titles (/50): 'Do We Use Only 10% of Our Brain? (Myth Busted)' 42 (chosen, 46 chars; the autocomplete wording), 'The 10% Brain Myth, Busted' 36. Thumbnails: A a brain with a red MYTH stamp (chosen). Hooks: 'You only use ten percent of your brain. Everyone says it. Is it true?' (chosen), 'Your brain is 90% idle. Right?'. Gap: SEO run 27 Nov: autocomplete 'do we use only 10 percent of our brain' (title wording); outlier videos are 3-5 minute brain-myth explainers, 7 % are Shorts;  structure = myth card, a test (what damage would show) and an energy-share bar, different from the other two videos of the day; mechanism only, no medical advice. Claims: (1) brain imaging (PET, fMRI) shows activity in all regions, even in sleep, and no inactive area has been found - VERIFIED (MIT McGovern Institute 2024, Association for Psychological Science); (2) the brain is about 2 % of body weight but uses about 20 % of the body's energy - VERIFIED (MIT McGovern Institute, Britannica); (3) damage to almost any brain area causes some loss of ability, which would not happen if 90 % were unused - VERIFIED (Association for Psychological Science, Nature Neuroscience 2003); (4) about 65 % of survey respondents agreed with the 10 % statement - VERIFIED (cited by Britannica; not used in narration). Sources: MIT McGovern Institute, Association for Psychological Science, Britannica, Nature Neuroscience. Growth: lever = a new family test with a strong first-line hook (belief stated as fact) and a series promise (next myth, pinned comment asking for the next myth); policy check: settled science only, mechanism not medical advice, nothing sensitive. Quality gate 80/100.

scenes.text: You only use ten percent of your brain. Everyone says it. Is it true?
In this video: why that's a myth, and what your brain really does all day.
It's false. Brain scans show activity in every region, even while you sleep.
If ninety percent did nothing, damage there would change nothing. Is that what we see?
Your brain is two percent of your weight, yet it burns about twenty percent of your energy.
Nobody pays that energy bill for a brain that's ninety percent idle.
The real story: different parts work at different moments, but all of it has a job.

scenes.text: आप दिमाग़ का सिर्फ़ दस प्रतिशत इस्तेमाल करते हैं। सब यही कहते हैं। क्या यह सच है?
इस वीडियो में: यह मिथक क्यों है, और आपका दिमाग़ सच में दिन भर क्या करता है।
यह ग़लत है। ब्रेन स्कैन में हर हिस्से में हलचल दिखती है, नींद में भी।
अगर नब्बे प्रतिशत कुछ न करता, तो वहाँ नुक़सान से कुछ नहीं बदलता। क्या ऐसा दिखता है?
दिमाग़ आपके वज़न का दो प्रतिशत है, पर लगभग बीस प्रतिशत ऊर्जा ख़र्च करता है।
नब्बे प्रतिशत ख़ाली दिमाग़ के लिए कोई इतना ऊर्जा बिल नहीं भरता।
असली बात: अलग-अलग पल में अलग हिस्से काम करते हैं, पर हर हिस्से का काम है।
